item.title: SC Menu 2.2
item.description: - Added card expiration notification to show when a card is about to expire or is expired - Added ability to pick the events for notifications to show for (card inserted, card removed, card expired, certificate expired) - Certificate expiration notifications will now show the certificate name and days until expiration in the notification message (or expired if the certificate is expired). - Expanded insertion/removal automation to support compiled AppleScripts, script bundles, and applications, with a broader selection of script types in Preferences. - Added a --info command-line option for troubleshooting. Reports app and macOS versions, current user information, smartcard readers and drivers, certificate labels and public-key hashes, and paired/mapped identities. - Added structured command-line argument parsing and help using swift-argument-parser, with a --help option to show usage information. - Bug fixes and improvements to the card insertion/removal automation, including better handling of script execution errors and improved logging for troubleshooting. - Bug fixes around CryptoTokenKit, red locked card indicators, and card insertion/removal notifications. - Converted the Preferences Window from AppKit to SwiftUI - Updated Minimum System Version to macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) to support the new SwiftUI Preferences Window and other modern features. - Updated Sparkle Framework Package dependency to 2.10.0, Swift Subprocess Package dependency to 1.0.2, and Swift Argument Parser Package dependency to 1.8.2.
item.dc:creator: Bob Gendler

item.title: SC Menu 2.1
item.description: - Added configuration option to configure days to show notification until certificates expire (MDM or defaults write command) - Fixed issue with displaying com.apple.ctkcard:user - Updated to show new icon in Preferences window - Sped up UI changes and notifications on card insertion by moving certain functions to MainActor and async/await - Added Sparkle Framework for app updating
